  --navy:#0f3046;
  --navy-2:#17445d;
  --teal:#087987;
  --teal-dark:#05636f;
  --aqua:#dceff0;
  --water:#edf6f7;
  --sand:#f7f4ec;
  --bg:#eef4f6;
  --surface:rgba(255,255,255,.94);
  --surface-soft:rgba(255,255,255,.78);
  --line:#c8d8df;
  --line-strong:#a9c0ca;
  --muted:#5b707b;
  --danger:#a63a32;
  --success:#20705c;
  --shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(15,48,70,.08);
  --shadow-soft:0 3px 12px rgba(15,48,70,.06);
  --radius:10px
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
[hidden]{display:none!important}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{
  margin:0;
  min-height:100vh;
  color:var(--navy);
  font:14px/1.4 system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 9% 14%,rgba(8,121,135,.07),transparent 20%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 88% 18%,rgba(15,48,70,.055),transparent 23%),
    linear-gradient(180deg,#f7fafb 0%,var(--bg) 52%,#edf4f5 100%);
}
body::before{
  content:"";
  position:fixed;
  inset:94px 0 0;
  pointer-events:none;
  z-index:-1;
  opacity:.48;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 16% 92%,transparent 0 48%,rgba(8,121,135,.055) 49% 50%,transparent 51% 100%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 62% 96%,transparent 0 51%,rgba(15,48,70,.04) 52% 53%,transparent 54% 100%);
  background-size:520px 170px,680px 210px;
}
header{
  display:flex;
  gap:14px;
  align-items:center;
  min-height:82px;
  padding:11px max(24px,calc((100vw - 1480px)/2));
  color:#fff;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 18% -80%,rgba(125,212,218,.28),transparent 42%),
    linear-gradient(118deg,var(--navy) 0%,#10374e 55%,#0b5361 100%);
  box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(15,48,70,.16);
}
header img{
  width:54px;
  height:54px;
  border-radius:50%;
  border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.7);
  box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.14)
}
header h1{
  margin:0 0 1px;
  font-size:22px;
  line-height:1.15;
  letter-spacing:-.02em
}
header p{
  margin:1px 0;
  font-size:11px;
  opacity:.88
}
nav{
  position:sticky;
  top:0;
  z-index:40;
  display:flex;
  justify-content:center;
  flex-wrap:wrap;
  gap:4px;
  padding:7px 18px;
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(169,192,202,.75);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.93);
  backdrop-filter:blur(12px);
  box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(15,48,70,.045)
}
button,.button{
  border:1px solid transparent;
  border-radius:8px;
  padding:8px 13px;
  color:#fff;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0a8492,var(--teal-dark));
  box-shadow:0 2px 7px rgba(8,121,135,.16);
  font:600 13px/1.2 inherit;
  cursor:pointer;
  transition:transform .14s ease,box-shadow .14s ease,background .14s ease,border-color .14s ease
}
button:hover,.button:hover{
  transform:translateY(-1px);
  box-shadow:0 5px 13px rgba(8,121,135,.22)
}
button.secondary{
  color:var(--navy);
  background:#edf4f6;
  border-color:var(--line);
  box-shadow:none
}
button.danger{
  color:#fff;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#b64a42,#96342d)
}
button:disabled{
  opacity:.48;
  cursor:not-allowed;
  transform:none;
  box-shadow:none
}
button:focus-visible,
input:focus-visible,
select:focus-visible,
textarea:focus-visible,
summary:focus-visible{
  outline:3px solid #ddb13d;
  outline-offset:2px
}
nav button{
  min-width:auto;
  padding:7px 12px;
  color:var(--navy);
  background:transparent;
  border-color:transparent;
  border-radius:7px;
  box-shadow:none;
  font-size:12.5px
}
nav button:hover{
  color:var(--teal-dark);
  background:#e9f3f4;
  box-shadow:none;
  transform:none
}
nav button[aria-current=page]{
  color:#fff;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0b7b88,#075f6b);
  box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(8,121,135,.18)
}
.nav-group{
  position:relative;
  margin:0;
  padding:0;
  border:0;
  border-radius:7px;
  background:transparent;
  box-shadow:none
}
.nav-group>.nav-group-summary{
  display:flex;
  min-height:31px;
  align-items:center;
  gap:6px;
  margin:0!important;
  padding:7px 12px;
  border-radius:7px;
  color:var(--navy);
  background:transparent;
  cursor:pointer;
  font-size:12.5px;
  font-weight:500;
  list-style:none;
  transition:background .14s ease,color .14s ease
}
.nav-group>.nav-group-summary::-webkit-details-marker{
  display:none
}
.nav-group>.nav-group-summary::after{
  content:"▾";
  margin-left:2px;
  color:#6f8791;
  font-size:9px
}
.nav-group:hover>.nav-group-summary,
.nav-group[open]>.nav-group-summary{
  color:var(--teal-dark);
  background:#e9f3f4
}
.nav-group.active>.nav-group-summary{
  color:#fff;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0b7b88,#075f6b);
  box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(8,121,135,.18)
}
.nav-group.active>.nav-group-summary::after{
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.9)
}
.nav-submenu{
  position:absolute;
  z-index:120;
  top:calc(100% + 5px);
  left:0;
  min-width:190px;
  padding:6px;
  border:1px solid #c7d9df;
  border-radius:9px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.98);
  box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(15,48,70,.18);
  backdrop-filter:blur(12px)
}
.nav-submenu .nav-submenu-item{
  display:block;
  width:100%;
  margin:0;
  padding:8px 10px;
  text-align:left;
  white-space:nowrap
}
.nav-submenu .nav-submenu-item+ .nav-submenu-item{
  margin-top:2px
}
.nav-submenu .nav-submenu-item[aria-current=page]{
  color:#fff;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0b7b88,#075f6b)
}
main{
  width:min(1500px,calc(100% - 28px));
  margin:0 auto;
  padding:16px 0 24px
}
h2{
  margin:0 0 8px;
  font-size:21px;
  letter-spacing:-.02em
}
h3{
  margin:10px 0 8px;
  font-size:15px
}
p{
  margin:6px 0 10px
}
.card{
  margin-bottom:11px;
  padding:14px 16px;
  border:1px solid rgba(185,205,213,.92);
  border-radius:var(--radius);
  background:var(--surface);
  box-shadow:var(--shadow-soft)
}
.grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(170px,1fr));
  gap:9px 10px
}
.field{
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;
  gap:2px;
  min-width:0;
  font-size:11.5px;
  font-weight:560
}
.field>span{
  line-height:1.15
}
.field small{
  margin:1px 0 0;
  line-height:1.15;
  font-size:9.8px;
  font-weight:400
}
input,select,textarea{
  width:100%;
  min-height:32px;
  border:1px solid var(--line-strong);
  border-radius:7px;
  padding:6px 8px;
  color:var(--navy);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.98);
  font:400 13px/1.25 inherit;
  transition:border-color .14s ease,box-shadow .14s ease,background .14s ease
}
input:hover,select:hover,textarea:hover{
  border-color:#84a9b5
}
input:focus,select:focus,textarea:focus{
  border-color:var(--teal);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(8,121,135,.09);
  background:#fff
}
textarea{
  min-height:68px;
  resize:vertical
}
input[type=checkbox]{
  width:17px;
  min-height:17px;
  height:17px;
  align-self:flex-start;
  accent-color:var(--teal)
}
input[type=file]{
  min-height:35px;
  padding:5px 7px;
  font-size:12px
}
.actions{
  display:flex;
  flex-wrap:wrap;
  gap:7px;
  margin:11px 0 4px
}
.status{
  width:min(1500px,calc(100% - 28px));
  margin:8px auto 0;
  padding:9px 12px;
  border-radius:8px;
  white-space:pre-wrap;
  font-size:12.5px
}
.status:empty{display:none}
.status.error{
  color:#7d2820;
  background:#fff0ed;
  border:1px solid #efc3bd
}
.status.ok{
  color:#174f42;
  background:#e3f4ef;
  border:1px solid #b6ded2
}
body.processing-active{
  overflow:hidden
}
.processing-overlay{
  position:fixed;
  inset:0;
  z-index:9999;
  display:grid;
  place-items:center;
  padding:20px;
  background:rgba(10,35,49,.54);
  backdrop-filter:blur(6px)
}
.processing-panel{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:92px minmax(0,1fr);
  gap:18px;
  width:min(520px,calc(100vw - 32px));
  padding:22px 24px;
  border:1px solid rgba(178,211,217,.95);
  border-radius:15px;
  color:var(--navy);
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 0 0,rgba(8,121,135,.09),transparent 34%),
    rgba(255,255,255,.98);
  box-shadow:0 24px 70px rgba(4,27,40,.28)
}
.processing-visual{
  position:relative;
  display:grid;
  place-items:center;
  width:86px;
  height:86px
}
.processing-spinner{
  position:absolute;
  inset:0;
  border:7px solid #dcecef;
  border-top-color:var(--teal);
  border-right-color:#5aaab3;
  border-radius:50%;
  animation:pda-processing-spin .9s linear infinite
}
.processing-percent{
  position:relative;
  z-index:1;
  color:#0a5d68;
  font-size:20px;
  letter-spacing:-.03em
}
.processing-copy{
  min-width:0
}
.processing-title{
  margin:0 0 5px;
  color:#123e52;
  font-size:18px;
  line-height:1.15
}
.processing-message{
  min-height:20px;
  margin:0 0 4px;
  color:#284f61;
  font-size:13px;
  font-weight:650
}
.processing-remaining{
  margin:0 0 11px;
  color:#607985;
  font-size:11px
}
.processing-progress{
  position:relative;
  width:100%;
  height:10px;
  overflow:hidden;
  border-radius:999px;
  background:#dfecee;
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 2px rgba(15,48,70,.08)
}
.processing-progress-bar{
  width:0;
  height:100%;
  border-radius:inherit;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#0b7582,#1594a0);
  transition:width .32s ease
}
.processing-note{
  display:block;
  margin-top:8px;
  color:#748992;
  font-size:9px;
  line-height:1.25
}
@keyframes pda-processing-spin{
  to{transform:rotate(360deg)}
}
.hint{
  color:var(--muted);
  font-size:11.5px;
  font-weight:400
}
.warn{
  padding:8px 10px;
  border:1px solid #eadba0;
  border-radius:7px;
  color:#684f00;
  background:#fff7d9;
  white-space:pre-wrap;
  font-size:12px
}
.scroll{
  overflow:auto;
  border:1px solid #d7e2e7;
  border-radius:8px
}
table{
  width:100%;
  border-collapse:collapse;
  font-size:12.5px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.94)
}
th,td{
  padding:8px 9px;
  border-bottom:1px solid #dce6ea;
  text-align:left;
  vertical-align:middle
}
th{
  position:sticky;
  top:0;
  z-index:1;
  color:#27485a;
  background:#eef5f7;
  font-size:11.5px;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  letter-spacing:.035em
}
tbody tr:hover{
  background:#f4f9fa
}
td button{
  margin:1px;
  padding:5px 8px;
  font-size:11.5px
}
a{
  color:#066b91;
  overflow-wrap:anywhere
}
.stats{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(130px,1fr));
  gap:8px;
  margin-bottom:12px
}
.stat{
  padding:12px;
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:8px;
  color:var(--navy);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.9)
}
.stat strong{
  display:block;
  margin-bottom:2px;
  font-size:22px
}
details{
  margin:6px 0;
  padding:7px 9px;
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:8px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.91);
  box-shadow:0 2px 7px rgba(15,48,70,.035)
}
summary{
  cursor:pointer;
  font-size:12.5px;
  font-weight:650
}
details[open]>summary{
  margin-bottom:5px
}
pre{
  overflow-wrap:anywhere;
  white-space:pre-wrap;
  font-size:11.5px
}
.badge{
  display:inline-block;
  padding:3px 8px;
  border:1px solid #c5dfe2;
  border-radius:999px;
  color:#20525a;
  background:#eaf5f5;
  font-size:11px
}
.check{
  display:flex;
  gap:7px;
  align-items:flex-start;
  margin:7px 0
}
.check input{width:17px}
footer{
  width:min(1500px,calc(100% - 28px));
  margin:0 auto;
  padding:12px 0 18px;
  color:var(--muted);
  font-size:10.5px
}
@media(min-width:1200px){
  main{padding-top:14px}
  .grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr))}
}
@media(max-width:800px){
  header{padding:11px 16px}
  nav{
    justify-content:flex-start;
    overflow:visible;
    flex-wrap:wrap
  }
  nav button{white-space:nowrap}
  .nav-submenu{
    min-width:180px
  }
  main,.status,footer{width:min(100% - 20px,1500px)}
  .grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
}
@media(max-width:540px){
  .processing-panel{
    grid-template-columns:1fr;
    gap:10px;
    padding:18px;
    text-align:center
  }
  .processing-visual{
    width:74px;
    height:74px;
    margin:0 auto
  }
  .processing-percent{
    font-size:17px
  }
  .processing-message{
    min-height:0
  }
  .grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .card{padding:12px}
  header img{width:46px;height:46px}
  header h1{font-size:19px}
  table{min-width:620px}
}

/* =========================================================
   CABEÇALHO INSTITUCIONAL — MARCA CENTRALIZADA
   ========================================================= */
.app-header{
  min-height:126px;
  padding:0;
  color:#fff;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% -110%,rgba(131,221,225,.34),transparent 46%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 8% 20%,rgba(86,184,196,.12),transparent 24%),
    linear-gradient(118deg,#0d3147 0%,#10445a 52%,#0b5562 100%);
  box-shadow:0 5px 18px rgba(15,48,70,.18)
}
.app-header-inner{
  position:relative;
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:minmax(220px,1fr) auto minmax(220px,1fr);
  align-items:center;
  width:min(1480px,calc(100% - 40px));
  min-height:126px;
  margin:0 auto;
  padding:10px 0;
  gap:18px
}
.app-header-balance{
  min-width:0
}
.app-header-brand{
  justify-self:center;
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;
  gap:5px;
  min-width:320px;
  text-align:center
}
.app-brand-logo-wrap{
  position:relative;
  display:grid;
  place-items:center;
  width:78px;
  height:78px;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.46);
  border-radius:50%;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 35% 25%,rgba(255,255,255,.24),transparent 38%),
    rgba(255,255,255,.09);
  box-shadow:
    0 9px 23px rgba(2,21,31,.26),
    0 0 0 5px rgba(255,255,255,.055);
  transition:transform .18s ease,box-shadow .18s ease
}
.app-brand-logo-wrap::after{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  inset:-6px;
  border:1px solid rgba(180,233,236,.18);
  border-radius:50%;
  pointer-events:none
}
.app-brand-logo-wrap:hover{
  transform:translateY(-2px) scale(1.025);
  box-shadow:
    0 13px 28px rgba(2,21,31,.30),
    0 0 0 6px rgba(255,255,255,.07)
}
.app-brand-logo-image{
  display:block;
  width:66px!important;
  height:66px!important;
  object-fit:contain;
  border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.88)!important;
  border-radius:50%;
  background:#fff;
  box-shadow:0 3px 11px rgba(0,0,0,.18)!important
}
.app-header-copy h1{
  margin:0;
  color:#fff;
  font-size:25px;
  line-height:1.02;
  letter-spacing:-.025em;
  text-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.12)
}
.app-header-copy p{
  margin:3px 0 0;
  color:rgba(239,252,253,.90);
  font-size:10.5px;
  line-height:1.2;
  opacity:1
}
.app-header-user{
  justify-self:end;
  min-width:0;
  max-width:330px;
  padding:8px 10px;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.11);
  border-radius:10px;
  text-align:right;
  background:rgba(0,28,41,.12)
}
.app-header-user-label{
  display:block;
  margin-bottom:2px;
  color:rgba(204,241,243,.68);
  font-size:7.5px;
  font-weight:800;
  letter-spacing:.14em
}
.app-header-user p{
  margin:0;
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.94);
  font-size:10px;
  line-height:1.3;
  opacity:1
}
body::before{
  inset:126px 0 0
}

/* =========================================================
   NAVEGAÇÃO PRINCIPAL COM ÍCONES
   ========================================================= */
#nav{
  min-height:52px;
  gap:6px;
  padding:8px 18px;
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(169,192,202,.78);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.95);
  box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(15,48,70,.055)
}
#nav button,
#nav .nav-group-summary{
  min-height:35px;
  border-radius:9px
}
#nav button{
  display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;
  gap:7px;
  padding:7px 11px;
  font-size:12px;
  font-weight:620
}
.nav-direct{
  position:relative
}
.nav-icon{
  display:inline-grid;
  place-items:center;
  flex:0 0 auto;
  width:18px;
  height:18px;
  color:currentColor
}
.nav-icon svg{
  display:block;
  width:17px;
  height:17px;
  fill:none;
  stroke:currentColor;
  stroke-width:1.85;
  stroke-linecap:round;
  stroke-linejoin:round
}
.nav-label{
  display:inline-block;
  line-height:1
}
.nav-group>.nav-group-summary{
  gap:7px;
  padding:7px 11px;
  font-size:12px;
  font-weight:620
}
.nav-group>.nav-group-summary::after{
  margin-left:1px
}
.nav-group-summary .nav-icon{
  width:18px;
  height:18px
}
.nav-submenu{
  top:calc(100% + 7px);
  min-width:224px;
  padding:7px;
  border-radius:11px;
  box-shadow:0 16px 38px rgba(15,48,70,.17)
}
.nav-submenu .nav-submenu-item{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:flex-start;
  gap:8px;
  min-height:36px;
  padding:8px 10px;
  border-radius:8px;
  font-size:11.5px
}
.nav-submenu .nav-icon{
  width:17px;
  height:17px
}
#nav button[aria-current=page],
.nav-group.active>.nav-group-summary{
  box-shadow:0 4px 11px rgba(8,121,135,.22)
}
#nav button[aria-current=page] .nav-icon,
.nav-group.active>.nav-group-summary .nav-icon{
  color:#fff
}

  }

  }

  }

    gap:4px

    width:66px;

  }

  }

  }

<script>
window.PDA_MODULES.DEFESO = (()=>{
  const {
    el,card,call,status
  }=App;

  function moneyBR_(value){
    return Number(value||0).toLocaleString(
      'pt-BR',
      {
        minimumFractionDigits:2,
        maximumFractionDigits:2
      }
    );
  }

  function dateBR_(value){
    const s=String(value||'').slice(0,10);

    if(!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(s)){
      return String(value||'');
    }

    return s.slice(8,10)+'/'+s.slice(5,7)+'/'+s.slice(0,4);
  }

  function maskCpf_(input){
    const sync=()=>{
      const d=String(input.value||'')
        .replace(/\D/g,'')
        .slice(0,11);

      input.value=
        d
          .replace(/^(\d{3})(\d)/,'$1.$2')
          .replace(/^(\d{3})\.(\d{3})(\d)/,'$1.$2.$3')
          .replace(
            /^(\d{3})\.(\d{3})\.(\d{3})(\d{1,2}).*$/,
            '$1.$2.$3-$4'
          );
    };

    input.addEventListener('input',sync);
    input.addEventListener('blur',sync);
  }

  function recordText_(r){
    return [
      'ID: '+(r.id||'—'),
      'CPF: '+(r.cpfFormatado||'—'),
      'NIS: '+(r.nis||'—'),
      'Nome: '+(r.nome||'—'),
      'Município: '+(r.nomeIBGE||'—'),
      'UF: '+(r.ufSigla||'—'),
      'RGP: '+(r.rgp||'—'),
      'Portaria: '+(r.portaria||'—'),
      'Mês de referência: '+(dateBR_(r.dataMesReferencia)||'—'),
      'Data de emissão: '+(dateBR_(r.dataEmissaoParcela)||'—'),
      'Data do saque: '+(dateBR_(r.dataSaque)||'—'),
      'Parcela: '+(r.parcela||'—'),
      'Situação: '+(r.situacao||'—'),
      'Valor: R$ '+moneyBR_(r.valor)
    ].join('\n');
  }

  function renderResult_(area,result){
    area.replaceChildren();

    const stats=
      el(
        'div',
        undefined,
        'stats'
      );

    [
      [
        String(result.quantidade||0),
        'registros de 2025'
      ],
      [
        'R$ '+moneyBR_(result.valorTotal),
        'valor total localizado'
      ],
      [
        String(result.registrosForaPeriodo||0),
        'registros fora de 2025'
      ]
    ].forEach(([value,label])=>{
      const box=
        el(
          'div',
          undefined,
          'stat'
        );

      box.append(
        el(
          'strong',
          value
        ),
        el(
          'span',
          label
        )
      );

      stats.append(box);
    });

    area.append(stats);

    if(!result.registros||!result.registros.length){
      area.append(
        el(
          'p',
          'Nenhum registro com mês de referência em 2025 foi localizado para o CPF informado.',
          'warn'
        )
      );

      return;
    }

    result.registros.forEach((r,index)=>{
      const box=
        el(
          'details'
        );

      box.append(
        el(
          'summary',
          (
            r.parcela
              ?'Parcela '+r.parcela
              :'Registro '+(index+1)
          )+
          ' — '+
          (
            dateBR_(r.dataMesReferencia)||
            'sem mês de referência'
          )+
          ' — R$ '+
          moneyBR_(r.valor)
        )
      );

      box.append(
        el(
          'pre',
          recordText_(r)
        )
      );

      area.append(box);
    });
  }

  return async function(ctx){
    const root=ctx.root;

    const head=
      el(
        'div',
        undefined,
        'defeso-page-head'
      );

    head.append(
      el(
        'h2',
        'Consultar Defeso 2025'
      ),
      el(
        'p',
        'Consulta avulsa à API oficial do Portal da Transparência. Nenhum cadastro é criado ou alterado.',
        'hint'
      )
    );

    root.append(head);

    const search=
      card();

    search.classList.add(
      'defeso-search-card'
    );

    const icon=
      el(
        'div',
        undefined,
        'defeso-search-icon'
      );

    icon.innerHTML=
      '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="10.5" cy="10.5" r="5.8"></circle><path d="M15 15l5 5"></path><path d="M8.2 10.5h4.6"></path><path d="M10.5 8.2v4.6"></path></svg>';

    const content=
      el(
        'div'
      );

    content.append(
      el(
        'h3',
        'Consultar pagamento do Seguro-Defeso'
      ),
      el(
        'p',
        'Informe o CPF para localizar os registros cujo mês de referência esteja entre 01/01/2025 e 31/12/2025.',
        'hint'
      )
    );

    const row=
      el(
        'div',
        undefined,
        'defeso-query-row'
      );

    const field=
      el(
        'label',
        undefined,
        'field'
      );

    field.append(
      el(
        'span',
        'CPF'
      )
    );

    const cpf=
      el(
        'input'
      );

    cpf.type='text';
    cpf.placeholder='000.000.000-00';
    cpf.maxLength=14;
    cpf.inputMode='numeric';
    cpf.autocomplete='off';

    maskCpf_(cpf);
    field.append(cpf);

    const consult=
      el(
        'button',
        'Consultar Defeso 2025'
      );

    consult.type='button';

    const configured=
      !!(
        App.state.boot.portalTransparencia&&
        App.state.boot.portalTransparencia.configurada
      );

    consult.disabled=!configured;

    row.append(
      field,
      consult
    );

    const apiState=
      el(
        'small',
        configured
          ?'API oficial disponível.'
          :'API do Portal da Transparência não configurada. Solicite a configuração a um administrador.',
        configured
          ?'hint defeso-api-state'
          :'warn defeso-api-state'
      );

    content.append(
      row,
      apiState
    );

    search.append(
      icon,
      content
    );

    root.append(search);

    const resultArea=
      el(
        'section',
        undefined,
        'defeso-result'
      );

    root.append(resultArea);

    consult.onclick=async()=>{
      const codigo=
        String(cpf.value||'')
          .replace(/\D/g,'');

      if(!/^\d{11}$/.test(codigo)){
        status(
          'Informe um CPF completo no formato 000.000.000-00.',
          true
        );

        cpf.focus();
        return;
      }

      apiState.textContent=
        'Consultando a base oficial...';

      apiState.className=
        'hint defeso-api-state';

      try{
        const result=
          await call(
            'seguroDefesoConsultar',
            {
              codigo
            }
          );

        apiState.textContent=
          'Consulta concluída em '+
          String(result.consultadoEm||'')+
          '.';

        renderResult_(
          resultArea,
          result
        );

        status(
          'Consulta do Seguro-Defeso 2025 concluída.'
        );

      }catch(e){
        apiState.textContent=
          e.message||
          String(e);

        apiState.className=
          'warn defeso-api-state';

        status(
          e.message||
          String(e),
          true
        );
      }
    };

    cpf.addEventListener(
      'keydown',
      event=>{
        if(event.key==='Enter'){
          event.preventDefault();
          consult.click();
        }
      }
    );

    requestAnimationFrame(
      ()=>cpf.focus()
    );
  };
})();
</script>

<script>
window.PDA_MODULES.DIST = (()=>{
  const {
    el,button,call,alive,status
  }=App;

  function money_(value){
    return Number(value||0).toLocaleString(
      'pt-BR',
      {
        style:'currency',
        currency:'BRL'
      }
    );
  }

  function cpf_(value){
    const d=String(value||'')
      .replace(/\D/g,'');

    return d.length===11
      ?d.replace(
          /(\d{3})(\d{3})(\d{3})(\d{2})/,
          '$1.$2.$3-$4'
        )
      :String(value||'');
  }

  function assignmentCard_(task,users,refresh){
    const card=
      el(
        'article',
        undefined,
        'dist-task-card '+(
          task.situacao==='PENDENTE_ATRIBUICAO'
            ?'unassigned'
            :'assigned'
        )
      );

    const top=
      el(
        'div',
        undefined,
        'dist-task-top'
      );

    const copy=
      el(
        'div'
      );

    copy.append(
      el(
        'strong',
        task.pessoa
      ),
      el(
        'small',
        cpf_(task.cpf)+
        (
          task.cidade
            ?' · '+task.cidade
            :''
        )
      )
    );

    top.append(
      copy,
      el(
        'span',
        task.situacao==='PENDENTE_ATRIBUICAO'
          ?'SEM RESPONSÁVEL'
          :'ATRIBUÍDA',
        'dist-task-status'
      )
    );

    const info=
      el(
        'div',
        undefined,
        'dist-task-info'
      );

    [
      [
        'Jurisdição',
        task.jurisdicao||'—'
      ],
      [
        'Valor da causa',
        money_(task.valorCausa)
      ],
      [
        'Responsável atual',
        task.responsavelNome||
        task.responsavel||
        'Não atribuído'
      ]
    ].forEach(([label,value])=>{
      const item=el('div');

      item.append(
        el(
          'span',
          label
        ),
        el(
          'strong',
          value
        )
      );

      info.append(item);
    });

    const assign=
      el(
        'div',
        undefined,
        'dist-assign-row'
      );

    const field=
      el(
        'label',
        undefined,
        'field'
      );

    field.append(
      el(
        'span',
        'Atribuir distribuição para'
      )
    );

    const select=
      el(
        'select'
      );

    select.append(
      new Option(
        'Selecione o responsável',
        ''
      )
    );

    users.forEach(user=>{
      const label=[
        user.nome,
        user.funcao,
        user.email
      ].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');

      const option=
        new Option(
          label,
          user.email
        );

      if(
        String(
          task.responsavel||
          ''
        ).toLowerCase()===
        String(
          user.email||
          ''
        ).toLowerCase()
      ){
        option.selected=true;
      }

      select.append(option);
    });

    field.append(select);

    const save=
      button(
        task.responsavel
          ?'Reatribuir tarefa'
          :'Atribuir tarefa',
        async()=>{
          if(!select.value){
            throw new Error(
              'Selecione um usuário responsável pela distribuição.'
            );
          }

          const result=
            await call(
              'tarefaDistribuicaoAtribuir',
              {
                id:task.id,
                responsavel:select.value
              },
              true
            );

          status(
            'Tarefa atribuída a '+
            result.responsavel+
            '.'
          );

          await refresh();
        }
      );

    assign.append(
      field,
      save
    );

    card.append(
      top,
      info,
      assign
    );

    return card;
  }

  return async function(ctx){
    const root=ctx.root;

    const render=async()=>{
      root.replaceChildren();

      const data=
        await call(
          'distribuicaoFila'
        );

      if(!alive(ctx))return;

      const head=
        el(
          'div',
          undefined,
          'dist-head'
        );

      const headCopy=
        el(
          'div'
        );

      headCopy.append(
        el(
          'h2',
          'Distribuição'
        ),
        el(
          'p',
          'Atribua individualmente cada tarefa de distribuição aos usuários autorizados. Depois da atribuição, a tarefa aparecerá em Minhas tarefas para o responsável.',
          'hint'
        )
      );

      const reconcile=
        button(
          'Criar tarefas faltantes',
          async()=>{
            const result=
              await call(
                'tarefasDistribuicaoReconciliar',
                {},
                true
              );

            status(
              result.mensagem||
              'Tarefas reconciliadas.'
            );

            await render();
          },
          true
        );

      head.append(
        headCopy,
        reconcile
      );

      root.append(head);

      const stats=
        el(
          'div',
          undefined,
          'dist-stats'
        );

      [
        [
          data.indicadores.semResponsavel,
          'Sem responsável'
        ],
        [
          data.indicadores.atribuidas,
          'Atribuídas'
        ],
        [
          data.indicadores.concluidas,
          'Concluídas'
        ],
        [
          data.usuarios.length,
          'Usuários aptos a distribuir'
        ]
      ].forEach(([value,label])=>{
        const box=
          el(
            'div',
            undefined,
            'dist-stat'
          );

        box.append(
          el(
            'strong',
            String(value||0)
          ),
          el(
            'span',
            label
          )
        );

        stats.append(box);
      });

      root.append(stats);

      const workload=
        el(
          'section',
          undefined,
          'dist-workload'
        );

      workload.append(
        el(
          'h3',
          'Equipe de distribuição'
        )
      );

      const workloadGrid=
        el(
          'div',
          undefined,
          'dist-workload-grid'
        );

      data.usuarios.forEach(user=>{
        const assigned=
          data.tarefas.filter(t=>
            t.situacao!=='CONCLUIDA'&&
            String(t.responsavel||'').toLowerCase()===
            String(user.email||'').toLowerCase()
          ).length;

        const item=
          el(
            'div',
            undefined,
            'dist-user'
          );

        item.append(
          el(
            'strong',
            user.nome
          ),
          el(
            'small',
            (user.funcao||user.email)+
            ' · '+
            assigned+
            (
              assigned===1
                ?' tarefa pendente'
                :' tarefas pendentes'
            )
          )
        );

        workloadGrid.append(item);
      });

      if(!data.usuarios.length){
        workloadGrid.append(
          el(
            'p',
            'Nenhum usuário possui a permissão "Distribuir processos". Configure essa permissão em Administração.',
            'warn'
          )
        );
      }

      workload.append(workloadGrid);
      root.append(workload);

      const active=
        data.tarefas.filter(t=>
          t.situacao!=='CONCLUIDA'
        );

      const section=
        el(
          'section',
          undefined,
          'dist-section'
        );

      const sectionHead=
        el(
          'div',
          undefined,
          'dist-section-head'
        );

      sectionHead.append(
        el(
          'h3',
          'Fila de distribuição'
        ),
        el(
          'span',
          active.length+
          (
            active.length===1
              ?' tarefa'
              :' tarefas'
          ),
          'hint'
        )
      );

      section.append(sectionHead);

      const grid=
        el(
          'div',
          undefined,
          'dist-grid'
        );

      if(!active.length){
        grid.append(
          el(
            'div',
            'Não existem tarefas pendentes de distribuição.',
            'dist-empty'
          )
        );
      }else{
        active.forEach(task=>
          grid.append(
            assignmentCard_(
              task,
              data.usuarios,
              render
            )
          )
        );
      }

      section.append(grid);
      root.append(section);

      const completed=
        data.tarefas.filter(t=>
          t.situacao==='CONCLUIDA'
        );

      if(completed.length){
        const done=
          el(
            'details',
            undefined,
            'dist-completed'
          );

        done.append(
          el(
            'summary',
            'Distribuições concluídas ('+
            completed.length+
            ')'
          )
        );

        const doneGrid=
          el(
            'div',
            undefined,
            'dist-done-grid'
          );

        completed
          .slice(0,30)
          .forEach(task=>{
            const row=
              el(
                'div',
                undefined,
                'dist-done-row'
              );

            row.append(
              el(
                'strong',
                task.pessoa
              ),
              el(
                'span',
                task.jurisdicao||'—'
              ),
              el(
                'span',
                task.responsavelNome||
                task.responsavel||
                '—'
              )
            );

            doneGrid.append(row);
          });

        done.append(doneGrid);
        root.append(done);
      }
    };

    await render();
  };
})();
</script>

<script>
window.PDA_MODULES.MIN = (()=>{
  const {
    el,card,table,link,button,call,go,alive,searchUI,status
  }=App;

  return async function(ctx){
    const root=ctx.root;

    root.append(
      el(
        'h2',
        'Minutas'
      )
    );

    root.append(
      el(
        'p',
        'As minutas são vinculadas diretamente ao cadastro da pessoa.',
        'hint'
      )
    );

    if(!App.state.selection){
      await searchUI(
        root,
        p=>go(
          'MIN',
          p.id
        )
      );
      return;
    }

    const data=
      await call(
        'ficha',
        {
          pessoaId:App.state.selection
        }
      );

    if(!alive(ctx))return;

    const p=data.pessoa;

    root.append(
      el(
        'h3',
        p.nome
      )
    );

    const topActions=
      el(
        'div',
        undefined,
        'actions'
      );

    topActions.append(
      button(
        'Selecionar outra pessoa',
        ()=>{
          App.state.selection=null;
          return go('MIN');
        },
        true
      )
    );

    root.append(topActions);

    const box=
      card(
        'Petição inicial — Seguro-Defeso 2025'
      );

    const iniciais=
      (data.documentosPessoa||[])
        .filter(d=>
          d.vigente==='true'&&
          d.categoria==='INICIAL_SEGURO_DEFESO_2025'
        );

    box.append(
      el(
        'p',
        iniciais.length
          ?'Existe uma petição inicial vigente vinculada a esta pessoa.'
          :'Ainda não há petição inicial vigente vinculada a esta pessoa.',
        iniciais.length
          ?'badge'
          :'warn'
      )
    );

    const generate=
      button(
        iniciais.length
          ?'Gerar nova versão da inicial'
          :'Gerar petição inicial',
        async()=>{
          await call(
            'minutaInicialGerar',
            {
              pessoaId:p.id
            },
            true
          );

          status(
            'Petição inicial gerada e adicionada aos documentos da pessoa.'
          );

          await go(
            'MIN',
            p.id
          );
        }
      );

    box.append(generate);

    if(iniciais.length){
      table(
        box,
        [
          {
            key:'nome',
            label:'Arquivo'
          },
          {
            label:'Situação',
            value:d=>
              d.conferido==='true'
                ?'Vigente · Conferido'
                :'Vigente'
          }
        ],
        iniciais,
        d=>[
          link(
            d.url,
            'Abrir PDF'
          )
        ]
      );
    }

    root.append(box);
  };
})();
</script>

      'pt-BR',

  function cpf_(value){
    const d=String(value||'')

    const art=
      el(
        'div',
        undefined,

      );

    art.innerHTML=
      '<svg viewBox="0 0 1200 430" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice" aria-hidden="true">'+
      '<g class="water-lines">'+
      '<path d="M-40 315 C90 278 180 355 330 315 S580 280 720 320 S980 360 1240 308"></path>'+

      '<path class="net-line" d="M826 178c-40 28-63 58-73 99"></path>'+

      '<circle class="person-head" cx="870" cy="232" r="13"></circle>'+
      '<path class="person" d="M870 245l-10 41m10-31 28 16m-35-7-24 22"></path>'+

      '<path d="M350 82q12-12 24 0q12-12 24 0"></path>'+
      '</g>'+
      '</svg>';

  }

  return async function(ctx){

      {};

    const d=

        undefined,

      )
    );

    sectionTitle.firstChild.append(
      el(
        'h3',
        'O que você precisa fazer?'
      ),
      el(
        'p',
        'Acesse diretamente as ferramentas disponíveis para o seu perfil.',

      )

    root.append(sectionTitle);

        'section',
        undefined,

    const available=

        code:'PESS',

        primary:true

        'h3',

        'p',

        el(
          'p',
          'Nenhuma atividade registrada.',
          'hint'
        )
      );
    }else{
      d.atividades.forEach(item=>{
        const row=
          el(
            'div',
            undefined,
            'home-timeline-item'
          );

        row.append(
          el(
            'span',
            undefined,
            'home-timeline-dot'
          )
        );

        const copy=
          el(
            'div'
          );

        copy.append(
          el(
            'strong',
            item.descricao
          ),
          el(
            'small',
            dateTime_(item.data)+
            (
              item.usuario
                ?' · '+item.usuario
                :''
            )
          )
        );

        row.append(copy);
        timeline.append(row);
      });
    }

    activity.append(timeline);

    lower.append(
      recent,
      activity
    );

    root.append(lower);

    const jurisdictionEntries=
      Object.entries(
        d.jurisdicoes||{}
      )
        .sort((a,b)=>
          b[1]-a[1]
        );

    if(jurisdictionEntries.length){
      const territory=
        el(
          'section',
          undefined,
          'home-territory'
        );

      const territoryHead=
        el(
          'div',
          undefined,
          'home-panel-head'
        );

      territoryHead.append(
        el(
          'div'
        ),
        el(
          'span',
          'Atualizado em '+dateTime_(d.atualizadoEm),
          'home-updated'
        )
      );

      territoryHead.firstChild.append(
        el(
          'h3',
          'Abrangência dos cadastros'
        ),
        el(
          'p',
          'Distribuição das pessoas por jurisdição.',
          'hint'
        )
      );

      territory.append(
        territoryHead
      );

      const bars=
        el(
          'div',
          undefined,
          'home-territory-bars'
        );

      const max=
        Math.max(
          ...jurisdictionEntries.map(
            item=>Number(item[1]||0)
          ),
          1
        );

      jurisdictionEntries.forEach(([name,value])=>{
        const row=
          el(
            'div',
            undefined,
            'home-territory-row'
          );

        const label=
          el(
            'div',
            undefined,
            'home-territory-label'
          );

        label.append(
          el(
            'span',
            name
          ),
          el(
            'strong',
            number_(value)
          )
        );

        const track=
          el(
            'div',
            undefined,
            'home-territory-track'
          );

        const fill=
          el(
            'span',
            undefined,
            'home-territory-fill'
          );

        fill.style.width=
          Math.max(
            5,
            Math.round(
              Number(value||0)/
              max*
              100
            )
          )+'%';

        track.append(fill);

        row.append(
          label,
          track
        );

        bars.append(row);
      });

      territory.append(bars);
      root.append(territory);
    }
  };
})();
</script>

<script>
window.PDA_MODULES.PERF=async(token)=>{
  const App=window.App;
  const {el,card,button,status}=App,root=token.root,auth=window.PDA_AUTH;
  let result;
  try{result=await auth.request('authProfile',auth.getSessionToken());}catch(e){if(/AUTH:/.test(e.message))auth.sessionExpired(e.message);throw e;}
  if(!App.alive(token))return;
  const user=result.usuario;
  root.append(el('h2','Meu perfil'),el('p','Atualize seus dados e a senha de acesso.','hint'));
  const layout=el('div',undefined,'perf-layout'),personal=card('Dados do perfil'),security=card('Alterar senha');security.classList.add('perf-security');layout.append(personal,security);root.append(layout);
  const photo=el('img',undefined,'perf-avatar');photo.alt='Foto do perfil';photo.hidden=!result.foto;if(result.foto)photo.src=result.foto;personal.append(photo);
  const controls=el('div',undefined,'perf-photo-controls'),file=el('input');file.type='file';file.accept='image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp';file.setAttribute('aria-label','Inserir ou alterar foto');controls.append(file);personal.append(controls);
  let photoPayload=null,removePhoto=false,saving=false;
  controls.append(button('Remover foto',()=>{if(saving)return;photoPayload=null;removePhoto=true;file.value='';photo.removeAttribute('src');photo.hidden=true;},true));
  async function readPhoto(selected){
    if(!selected||selected.size>10*1024*1024)throw Error('Selecione uma imagem de até 10 MB.');
    const url=URL.createObjectURL(selected);
    try{
      const image=new Image();image.src=url;await image.decode();
      const canvas=document.createElement('canvas'),scale=Math.min(1,320/Math.max(image.width,image.height));
      canvas.width=Math.max(1,Math.round(image.width*scale));canvas.height=Math.max(1,Math.round(image.height*scale));
      const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');ctx.fillStyle='#ffffff';ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);ctx.drawImage(image,0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
      const data=canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg',.85);return {base64:data.split(',')[1],mime:'image/jpeg',preview:data};
    }finally{URL.revokeObjectURL(url);}
  }
  file.onchange=async()=>{
    if(saving)return;
    file.disabled=true;
    try{if(!file.files[0])return;const payload=await readPhoto(file.files[0]);if(!App.alive(token))return;photoPayload=payload;removePhoto=false;photo.src=payload.preview;photo.hidden=false;status('Foto preparada. Clique em Salvar perfil para confirmar.');}
    catch(e){file.value='';status(e.message||String(e),true);}finally{file.disabled=false;}
  };
  function input(form,label,name,value='',type='text',required=true){
    const wrap=el('label',label),n=el('input');n.name=name;n.type=type;n.value=value;n.required=required;
    if(type==='password'){n.maxLength=4096;n.autocomplete=name==='novaSenha'?'new-password':'current-password';}else n.maxLength=name==='nome'?140:name==='nomeUsuario'?80:254;
    wrap.append(n);form.append(wrap);return n;
  }
  const form=el('form',undefined,'perf-form');personal.append(form);
  const name=input(form,'Nome completo','nome',user.nome),username=input(form,'Nome de usuário','nomeUsuario',user.nomeUsuario||user.nome),email=input(form,'E-mail de acesso','email',user.email,'email'),current=input(form,'Senha atual (para trocar o e-mail)','senhaAtual','','password',false);
  const save=el('button','Salvar perfil');save.type='submit';form.append(save);
  const passForm=el('form',undefined,'perf-form');security.append(passForm);
  const oldPass=input(passForm,'Senha atual','senhaAtual','','password'),newPass=input(passForm,'Nova senha','novaSenha','','password');
  const change=el('button','Alterar senha');change.type='submit';passForm.append(change);
  async function saveAction(job){
    if(saving)return;saving=true;root.setAttribute('aria-busy','true');root.querySelectorAll('button,input').forEach(n=>n.disabled=true);
    try{await job();}catch(e){if(/AUTH:/.test(e.message))auth.sessionExpired(e.message);status(e.message||String(e),true);}
    finally{saving=false;root.removeAttribute('aria-busy');root.querySelectorAll('button,input').forEach(n=>n.disabled=false);}
  }
  form.onsubmit=e=>{e.preventDefault();saveAction(async()=>{
    const response=await auth.request('authUpdateProfile',auth.getSessionToken(),{
      versao:user.versao,nome:name.value,nomeUsuario:username.value,email:email.value,senhaAtual:current.value,
      removerFoto:removePhoto,base64:photoPayload?photoPayload.base64:'',mime:photoPayload?photoPayload.mime:''
    });
    current.value='';auth.acceptSession(response);await App.start('PERF');status('Perfil atualizado.');
  });};
  passForm.onsubmit=e=>{e.preventDefault();saveAction(async()=>{
    const response=await auth.request('authChangePassword',auth.getSessionToken(),oldPass.value,newPass.value);
    oldPass.value='';newPass.value='';auth.acceptSession(response);await App.start('PERF');status('Senha alterada. As outras sessões foram encerradas.');
  });};
};
</script>

<script>
window.PDA_MODULES.PROC = (()=>{
  const {
    el,table,button,call,go,alive
  }=App;

  function cpf_(value){
    const d=String(value||'')
      .replace(/\D/g,'');

    return d.length===11
      ?d.replace(
          /(\d{3})(\d{3})(\d{3})(\d{2})/,
          '$1.$2.$3-$4'
        )
      :String(value||'');
  }

  function date_(value){
    const d=new Date(value);

    if(Number.isNaN(d.getTime())){
      return '—';
    }

    return d.toLocaleString(
      'pt-BR',
      {
        day:'2-digit',
        month:'2-digit',
        year:'numeric',
        hour:'2-digit',
        minute:'2-digit'
      }
    );
  }

  return async function(ctx){
    const root=ctx.root;

    root.append(
      el(
        'h2',
        'Processos'
      ),
      el(
        'p',
        'Processos cadastrados automaticamente quando uma tarefa de distribuição é concluída.',
        'hint'
      )
    );

    const rows=
      await call(
        'processos'
      );

    if(!alive(ctx))return;

    table(
      root,
      [
        {
          key:'numero',
          label:'Processo TRF4'
        },
        {
          key:'pessoa',
          label:'Pessoa'
        },
        {
          label:'CPF',
          value:r=>cpf_(r.cpf)
        },
        {
          key:'jurisdicao',
          label:'Jurisdição'
        },
        {
          label:'Distribuído em',
          value:r=>date_(r.distribuidoEm)
        },
        {
          key:'responsavel',
          label:'Responsável'
        }
      ],
      rows,
      r=>[
        button(
          'Abrir cadastro',
          ()=>{
            App.state.selection=r.pessoaId;
            return go(
              'ACOMP',
              r.pessoaId
            );
          }
        )
      ]
    );
  };
})();
</script>

  border:1px solid #b9d3d9;
  border-radius:13px;
  color:#173f51;
  background:#fff;
  box-shadow:0 24px 70px rgba(6,35,48,.30)
}
.task-process-shell{
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column
}
.task-process-head{
  display:flex;
  align-items:flex-start;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:10px;
  padding:13px 15px;
  color:#fff;
  background:linear-gradient(145deg,#0b6674,#0b8490)
}
.task-process-head h3{
  margin:0;
  color:#fff;
  font-size:15px
}
.task-process-head p{
  margin:2px 0 0;
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.82);
  font-size:9px
}
.task-process-head button{
  min-height:27px;
  padding:4px 8px;
  color:#fff;
  border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.24);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.12)
}
.task-process-body{
  padding:13px 15px 15px
}
.task-process-body>.field{
  margin-top:9px
}
.task-process-body input{
  font-family:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Consolas,monospace;
  letter-spacing:.02em
}
.task-process-actions{
  justify-content:flex-end;
  margin-top:10px
}
.task-dialog-shell{
  display:flex;
  max-height:90vh;
  flex-direction:column
}
.task-dialog-head{
  display:flex;
  align-items:flex-start;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:12px;
  padding:14px 16px 12px;
  color:#fff;
  background:linear-gradient(145deg,#0b6674,#0b8490)
}
.task-dialog-head h3{
  margin:0;
  color:#fff;
  font-size:16px
}
.task-dialog-head p{
  margin:3px 0 0;
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.84);
  font-size:9.5px
}
.task-dialog-head button{
  min-height:28px;
  padding:4px 8px;
  color:#fff;
  border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.25);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.12)
}
.task-dialog-body{
  overflow:auto;
  padding:13px 15px 15px
}
.task-distribution-banner{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1.2fr .8fr .8fr;
  gap:7px;
  margin-bottom:9px
}
.task-distribution-banner>div{
  padding:9px 10px;
  border:1px solid #c6dce1;
  border-radius:8px;
  background:#f2f8f9
}
.task-distribution-banner span{
  display:block;
  color:#6c828b;
  font-size:8.5px
}
.task-distribution-banner strong{
  display:block;
  margin-top:2px;
  color:#0b6571;
  font-size:11px
}
.task-detail-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:6px;
  margin-bottom:10px
}
.task-detail-item{
  min-width:0;
  padding:7px 8px;
  border:1px solid #dae6e9;
  border-radius:7px;
  background:#fbfdfd
}
.task-detail-item span{
  display:block;
  color:#72868e;
  font-size:8.3px
}
.task-detail-item strong{
  display:block;
  margin-top:2px;
  overflow-wrap:anywhere;
  color:#2f5260;
  font-size:9.7px
}
.task-dialog-section{
  margin-top:10px
}
.task-dialog-section h4{
  margin:0 0 6px;
  color:#173f51;
  font-size:11px
}
.task-lawyers{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:5px
}
.task-lawyer{
  padding:7px 8px;
  border:1px solid #d5e4e7;
  border-radius:7px;
  color:#315663;
  background:#f8fbfc;
  font-size:9px
}
.task-docs-head{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:8px;
  margin-bottom:6px
}
.task-docs-head h4{
  margin:0
}
.task-download-all{
  min-height:28px;
  padding:5px 9px;
  border-color:#b8d5da;
  color:#0b6572;
  background:#edf7f8;
  box-shadow:none;
  font-size:8.8px;
  white-space:nowrap
}
.task-download-all:hover{
  color:#fff;
  border-color:#0b7884;
  background:#0b7884;
  box-shadow:none
}
.task-docs{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:5px
}
.task-doc{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;
  gap:8px;
  align-items:center;
  padding:7px 8px;
  border:1px solid #d5e3e7;
  border-radius:7px;
  background:#fbfdfd
}
.task-doc strong{
  display:block;
  color:#315461;
  font-size:9.2px
}
.task-doc small{
  display:block;
  margin-top:1px;
  overflow:hidden;
  color:#7a8d94;
  font-size:8px;
  text-overflow:ellipsis;
  white-space:nowrap
}
.task-doc a{
  font-size:8.5px
}
.task-dialog-actions{
  position:sticky;
  bottom:0;
  display:flex;
  justify-content:flex-end;
  gap:6px;
  margin:12px -15px -15px;
  padding:9px 15px;
  border-top:1px solid #d6e3e6;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.97)
}
.task-complete-box{
  margin-top:9px;
  padding:10px;
  border:1px solid #bcd8de;
  border-radius:9px;
  background:#f1f8f9
}
.task-complete-box h4{
  margin:0 0 4px;
  font-size:11px
}
.task-complete-row{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:minmax(220px,1fr) auto auto;
  gap:6px;
  align-items:end;
  margin-top:7px
}
.task-complete-row .field{
  margin:0
}
@media(max-width:980px){
  .tasks-grid{
    grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))
  }
  .task-detail-grid{
    grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))
  }
}
@media(max-width:650px){
  .tasks-grid,
  .task-lawyers,
  .task-docs,
  .task-distribution-banner,
  .task-detail-grid,
  .task-complete-row{
    grid-template-columns:1fr
  }
  .task-dialog{
    width:calc(100vw - 16px)
  }
  .task-dialog-actions{
    flex-direction:column
  }
  .task-dialog-actions button{
    width:100%
  }
  .task-docs-head{
    align-items:stretch;
    flex-direction:column
  }
  .task-download-all{
    width:100%
  }
}
</style>
